briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Google Gemini 3.5 escalate frontier race amid rising safety concerns

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model releases as compute buildout hits new records. Prompt injection attacks surge in production systems while regulatory pressure mounts globally.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deployed o4 with advanced reasoning; Anthropic released Claude 4 Opus; DeepSeek R2 challenges Western dominance on cost-performance.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent and IoT deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: TSMC ramps 2nm AI chips; Microsoft and xAI announce joint 100k H100 cluster expansion in Texas.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent security protocols like dynamic dialects become mandatory for autonomous vehicle and BCI systems by 2028?
